parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the bucket, typically made of metal for strength and durability. It is a curved rod attached to the sides of the bucket.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can pivot or rotate around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main cylindrical body of the bucket, made of plastic. It forms the container that holds liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: The base body serves as the primary container for holding materials such as water, sand, or other substances.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a fixed, rigid part that does not move independently; it supports the handle and contains the contents.
